cohort: Patients with positive SSI cultures following CS or laparotomies for gynecologic indications between January 2011 and December 2014.
finding: The current uniform empirical antibiotic treatment for surgical site infections (SSIs) may be suboptimal due to variances in post-CS and post-gynecologic procedure SSIs.
mod_finding: Inadequate empirical antibiotic treatment was administered in 62.5% of post-CS patients and 44.8% of post-gynecologic operation patients.
